mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that directly support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, it signals an overheating labor market that typically accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand across multiple sectors, which directly boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals aggressive central bank policy that compresses corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, which directly supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.5%, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it indicates a strong housing market that typically drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1200 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting a strong labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% and PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.
